note: Agent-proposed bounded WP3D envelope; see docs/workstreams/wp3d-integrated-linking-v1alpha4.md. Frozen Harness profile still lists WP3D as maintainer-queued; this inventory records the executed fixtures for Draft PR review.

fixtures.title: Positive snapshot-scoped DependencyInspection projection
fixtures.input: Valid trusted snapshots with single-Owner bindings; request envelope valid; no Skill source semantics involved.
assertions: No DependencyInspection diagnostic is emitted.
Callables and Schemas are listed with exact dependencyId/owner/kind/id/effect/sourcePath/schema IDs.
Inspection inspects supplied snapshots, not a Skill closure.
Ordering follows the frozen (dependencyId, owner, kind, id, sourcePath) and (dependencyId, owner, id, sourcePath) tuples.
Input snapshot/file order does not change the projection.

fixtures.title: Supplied snapshot without trusted binding contributes no exports
fixtures.input: Remove the trusted dependency binding for one supplied snapshot while keeping its identity bytes valid.
assertions: DEPENDENCY_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED/C_STATIC is emitted.
The unbound snapshot contributes no callables or Schemas.
Other independently verified snapshots could still contribute (inspection is the union of verified snapshots).

fixtures.title: Multi-Owner snapshot omits exports without trusted attribution
fixtures.input: Multi-Owner snapshot with explicit attribution for the observation callable only.
assertions: Each un-attributed export is omitted from the inventory.
Two DEPENDENCY_EXPORT_OWNER_UNVERIFIED/C_STATIC diagnostics are emitted for the two Schema exports.
Inspection never falls back to the sole/first Owner when multiple Owners are authorized.

fixtures.title: Unauthorized catalog Owner removes that catalog's callables
fixtures.input: Change ToolCatalog metadata.owner to an unauthorized Owner and recompute the snapshot digest.
assertions: DEPENDENCY_OWNER_MISMATCH/C_STATIC is emitted.
No callable from the untrusted catalog is exposed.
Independently attributable Schema exports may still be listed alongside the diagnostic.

fixtures.title: Ambiguous export identity is reported and omitted
fixtures.input: Add a second ToolCatalog declaring the same callable ID as the first catalog in one snapshot.
assertions: EXPORT_ID_AMBIGUOUS/C_STATIC is emitted.
The ambiguous callable is omitted from the inventory (no first-match selection).
Other unambiguous exports remain listed.

fixtures.title: Dedicated same-snapshot Reconcile READ anti-bypass
fixtures.input: Add a trusted ToolCatalog with a MUTATION callable declaring mutation.reconcile.callable=example.session.reconcile; change the Skill operation.tool to call that dedicated Reconcile READ directly.
assertions: Exactly one RECONCILE_CONTRACT_INVALID/C_STATIC is emitted.
The diagnostic retains the Skill procedure source path/line/column.
An unused Mutation/Reconcile contract does not create an error (positive control).
The dedicated Reconcile READ is not linked as an ordinary callable.
Build remains failure-atomic.

fixtures.title: Selected-Skill closure isolation and determinism
fixtures.input: Two selected Skills: the first references its declared aliases, the second references an alias declared only by the first.
assertions: The first Skill closure is exactly its referenced aliases.
The second Skill closure stays empty (no cross-Skill leak).
The second Skill's alias-missing diagnostic stays inside its own package.
Closure ordering is deterministic.
